I have three sets of these car lift dollies and they are forever in my way. Contemplated one of these Dolly racks for a while and finally found this one that is actually reasonably price. It only took about 5 minutes to assemble, you will need a 17 mm and 19 mm wrench or socket and that's it. Overall it is a very sturdy unit. The swivel wheels are of decent quality and the welds look okay. This isn't a precision piece, I did find a few minor deficiencies in the welds however I have OCD with things like that and again, this is such a basic item, I wasn't concerned. The first set I put on where am I heaviest Duty 1,800 lb each dollies which are definitely bigger than your standard ones. The fit is perfect in that there's not much space wasted but at the same time you're not struggling to get them into place because it's too snug. Once it's weighed down, it rolls quite easily. Very impressed for the cost!
Went together easy. My dollies fit on there perfect. Fits up against the wall... What more can I ask for...
